A hall has 1,250 seats. At 7 pm, 880 seats are filled. At 8 pm, there are 40 empty seats. How many seats were filled between 7 pm and 8 pm? Show your method seats

Each day, a school has • break from 10:15 am to 10:30 am • lunchtime from 12:40 pm to 1:30 pm. What is the total time the school has for breaks and lunchtime in a 5-day week? Show your method hours minutes
